title: [KDE Plasma: Power and Battery widget] Indicate in the tray icon if an app is blocking sleep
line: The Power and Battery tray icon now shows the blocked-sleep icon, and its tooltip says so, when an app is blocking sleep.
explanation: The Power and Battery applet only switched to the 'sleep blocked' icon and became active in the tray when the user blocked sleep manually. Sleep inhibitions requested by apps were listed only inside the popup, so with the icon hidden or showing a plain battery nobody noticed. The applet now counts active app inhibitions that block sleep and treats them like manual blocking: same blocked icon while not on battery, active status so 'Shown when relevant' reveals it, and a tooltip line 'An application is blocking sleep' / '%1 applications are blocking sleep'.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: show when an app is blocking sleep

The tray icon only changed when sleep was blocked manually, so an app
blocking sleep went unnoticed until the popup was opened. Show the same
blocked icon and make the applet active, and say so in the tooltip.

BUG: 520671

patches.diff:
From 2dc27dab7228b14bacb2961dbd8ad0e2fd708046 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:57:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/batterymonitor: show when an app is blocking sleep

The tray icon only changed when sleep was blocked manually, so an app
blocking sleep went unnoticed until the popup was opened. Show the same
blocked icon and make the applet active, and say so in the tooltip.

BUG: 520671
---
 applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml |  7 ++++---
 applets/batterymonitor/main.qml                  | 11 ++++++++++-
 2 files changed, 14 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 0a02b660f..c5433a8ce 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@ MouseArea {
     required property bool isDischarging
 
     required property bool isManuallyInhibited
+    required property bool isSleepBlockedByApps
     required property bool isInDefaultPowerProfile
     required property bool isInPowersaveProfile
     required property bool isInBalancedProfile
@@ -50,19 +51,19 @@ MouseArea {
                                         : isInPerformanceProfile ? "battery-profile-performance-symbolic"
                                         : Plasmoid.icon
 
-    readonly property string powerModeIconSrc: isManuallyInhibited
+    readonly property string powerModeIconSrc: isManuallyInhibited || isSleepBlockedByApps
             ? "system-suspend-inhibited-symbolic"
             : !isInDefaultPowerProfile
             ? activeProfileIconSrc
             : Plasmoid.icon
 
-    // Shown for no batteries or manual inhibition while not discharging
+    // Shown for no batteries or inhibition while not discharging
     Kirigami.Icon {
         id: powerModeIcon
 
         anchors.fill: parent
 
-        visible: root.isConstrained && (!root.hasInternalBatteries || (root.isManuallyInhibited && !root.isDischarging))
+        visible: root.isConstrained && (!root.hasInternalBatteries || ((root.isManuallyInhibited || root.isSleepBlockedByApps) && !root.isDischarging))
         source: root.powerModeIconSrc
         active: root.containsMouse
     }
diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
index 7999bddb3..1fe66925a 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
@@ -99,8 +99,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     LayoutMirroring.enabled: Application.layoutDirection === Qt.RightToLeft
     LayoutMirroring.childrenInherit: true
 
+    readonly property int numAppsBlockingSleep: inhibitionControl.requestedInhibitions.filter(inh => inh.active && inh.behaviors.includes("sleep")).length
+
     Plasmoid.status: {
-        if (inhibitionControl.isManuallyInhibited || !powerProfilesControl.isInDefaultPowerProfile) {
+        if (inhibitionControl.isManuallyInhibited || numAppsBlockingSleep > 0 || !powerProfilesControl.isInDefaultPowerProfile) {
             return PlasmaCore.Types.ActiveStatus;
         }
 
@@ -171,6 +173,12 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             parts.push(i18n("Middle-click to disable automatic sleep and screen locking"));
         }
 
+        if (numAppsBlockingSleep > 0) {
+            parts.push(i18np("An application is blocking sleep",
+                             "%1 applications are blocking sleep",
+                             numAppsBlockingSleep));
+        }
+
         if (powerProfilesControl.isPowerProfileDaemonInstalled) {
             if (powerProfilesControl.isInPerformanceProfile) {
                 if (powerProfilesControl.isHeldOnPowerProfile) {
@@ -223,6 +231,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         isDischarging: !batteryControl.pluggedIn
 
         isManuallyInhibited: inhibitionControl.isManuallyInhibited
+        isSleepBlockedByApps: batterymonitor.numAppsBlockingSleep > 0
         isInDefaultPowerProfile: powerProfilesControl.isInDefaultPowerProfile
         isInPowersaveProfile: powerProfilesControl.isInPowersaveProfile
         isInBalancedProfile: powerProfilesControl.isInBalancedProfile
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: kde-inhibit --power holds a sleep inhibition, yet the tray shows the normal battery icon and the tooltip doesn't mention it.
Fix: same inhibition, the tray shows the blocked-sleep icon and the tooltip says 'An application is blocking sleep'.
